constat.label: THE PROBLEM
constat.title: What CBT therapists face every day

card1.title: The adherence challenge
card1.text: Between appointments, patient motivation can decline. Without structured support, nearly 25% of follow-ups are interrupted prematurely, limiting the impact of your clinical work.

card2.title: The lack of dedicated tools
card2.text: Without professional tools, follow-up often relies on scattered materials (PDFs, paper). It's difficult to individualize exercises without significantly increasing your daily workload.

card3.title: Lost clinical time
card3.text: Reconstructing the context of the past week consumes precious minutes at the start of each session. This missing visibility hinders the fluidity of therapeutic work.

fonctionnement.title: A dual interface designed for the therapeutic alliance.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: Does UMi replace the psychologist?
items.answer: UMi is an extension of your practice, never a substitute. The app is designed to be useful only within a follow-up with a practitioner. It does not diagnose, it does not make decisions for the patient. This limit is a founding commitment, not a communication precaution.

items.question: Is the data truly secure?
items.answer: The infrastructure relies on HDS-certified hosting in France. Health data is encrypted at rest and in transit. The patient controls what they share with you: you never see raw clinical content without their explicit consent.

items.question: Will it increase my workload?
items.answer: That's precisely the constraint we set for ourselves. You configure the tool once, and the AI handles patient contextualization. You check a dashboard before each session — thirty seconds. No additional input is required.

items.question: Is UMi only for CBT practitioners?
items.answer: The MVP exercise library is rooted in cognitive-behavioral approaches. If you work with other approaches, UMi remains usable but the proposed exercises won't all be relevant. We will progressively open the platform to other modalities.

items.question: What exactly do I see of what my patient does?
items.answer: At MVP stage, you see engagement metadata: completed exercises, frequency, date of last use. Not the content of responses. This separation is a conscious choice: it protects the therapeutic alliance and avoids out-of-session judgment biases.

items.question: When will the MVP be available?
items.answer: A closed beta is opening in the coming months with about twenty pilot CBT practitioners. By joining the early-bird list, you get priority access and benefit from the preferential rate.
